name: REALISTIC OutWest Chicago HOOD TESTING
desc:
Welcome to OutWest Chicago HOOD TESTING 🌃

Experience a realistic hood-style gun testing environment, centered around firearms and street-level PvP.

 Looking for a deeper experience? Check out the full version of the game by searching Chicago Nexus or visiting our group page!

[How to Play]
🎲 Spawn with a randomized loadout
⚔️ Engage in PvP combat with other players
🔓 Build killstreaks to unlock special weaponry

💡 Note: All firearms deal consistent base damage; there are no headshot multipliers.

🖥️ PC Controls
Left-Click: Shoot
Right-Click: ADS
R: Reload
Shift: Run

🎮 Console Controls
R2: Shoot
L2: ADS
X: Reload
L3: Run

🔫 Gamepass Selection Menu
• PC/Mobile: Tap the top bar button
• Console: Press the D-Pad Up button

Have suggestions, found a bug, or need to report an exploiter? Join the Server Communications socials below!
